summary: RETEST iteration_3 bug. FIX VERIFIED ✅. Option A (persistent <Player> kept mounted, toggled via CSS display in App.js, with STABLE SpotifyPlayer key='yourfm-spotify-player') fully resolves the crash. Across all required flows (1st open, back-and-forth on same station, edit + reopen, A→B→A switch), there is ZERO webpack-dev-server overlay, ZERO 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' pageerror, and the Spotify SDK initializes EXACTLY ONCE ('✓ Spotify player instance captured' appears exactly 1 time in the entire session). player-layer stays in DOM permanently and only toggles display between 'block' (player view) and 'none' (stations/edit/create views). Back-from-player button remains clickable in every iteration. POST /api/spotify/tracks fires per station (200, 48-50 tracks). Only pageerror observed is the unrelated 'No supported keysystem was found.' which is expected EME/DRM message in headless automation (no Spotify Premium device) and was explicitly flagged as expected in the review request.
critical_code_review_comments: Player.jsx is ~725 lines; should be split into PlayerCore / Visualizer / BumperManager modules (carried over from iteration_3 — not blocking).

Player.jsx polling logs 'Polling: No state available' every second indefinitely in headless automation (no Premium device). Not a bug, but consider lowering log verbosity or stopping the poller after N consecutive null states to reduce console noise.

App.js conditional `{spotifyToken && currentStation && (...)}` is correct — player-layer only mounts after first station selection. Verified player-layer remains in DOM after that (display toggles only), which is exactly what the fix requires.
test_credentials: Auto-auth via ?spotify_auth=success — stored Spotify token auto-refreshes. No app login.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug FIXED via persistent-mount approach. Key invariants verified: (1) sdk_inits_count == 1 across entire session, (2) iframe#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay never appears, (3) player-layer present in DOM after first station open and only toggles display, (4) no 'reading length' pageerrors. Only remaining console noise: 'Polling: No state available' loop (expected without Spotify Premium device) and EME 'No supported keysystem was found.' (expected in headless Chromium). Neither affects user-facing functionality.
